Historical whole-pathway context; E,E versus Z,E substrate issue; compare gallate and protocatechuate branches without claiming whole-route equivalence.
Reagents and coupled detection enzymes; not pathway participant claims.
KT2440 gene origins, pET29a/pVLT-31, truncation and variants; E6 PmdE BAI50711.1 codon-optimized construct; primers available on request only.
All recombinant hosts E. coli BL21 except GalB KT2442 native-host overexpression; no new organism occurrence edge for expression host.
GalA iron/DTT storage; GalB three chromatographic steps; GalD retained His6; LigJ His6 removal.
Bradford, SDS-PAGE, gel filtration; prepare oligomeric context.
GalBNt exact deletion; zinc anomalous evidence; no bound substrate/product structure.
Combined GalA/GalD oxygenated preparation, conversion percentages and chromatographic separation.
GalB-dependent HMG dehydration as side-substrate preparation; not core gallate route.
KT2442 expression explicitly assigned; ICP-MS iron insufficient and ferrozine used.
EDTA 12 h conditions, metal loading at least 1 h, Fe2+ anaerobic preparation and air-exposure test.
PAR assay, free/bound metal and dissociation fit; Eq1-2 inspected.
25 C duplicated assays, pH and metal specificity conditions, residual activity; all six equations and polarimetry method inspected.
GalB native-host versus recombinant yields and truncation origin; no per-batch kinetic host assignment.
Rossmann-like fold, two asymmetric-unit protomers, Zn pocket; structure uses GalBNt.
D3 hexamer interpretation plus gel filtration; two asymmetric-unit copies not a biological dimer.
His14/Asp17/Glu48/His127/water coordination; multiple Glu48 conformers, partial water occupancy possibility.
PIG-L structural comparisons and hypothesized residues are comparative context, not extra pathway proteins.
Native-host zinc occupancy, chelation/rescue, alternative metals, reversibility and optical products.
Substrate and enzyme ionizations conditional to assay; numeric and figure-caption inconsistencies retained.
All tested residue changes retained as conditional engineered evidence; glucosamine negative not positive inhibition.
Coupled reaction substitutions; no direct OMA hydration; GalC reagent identity not individually described.
R. palustris LigJ structural comparison is not same protein as E6 assay LigJ; no cross-species accession collapse.
MultiGeneBlast sampled homology supports computational distribution only.
Physiological metal unresolved; historical NMR assignment not repeated; optical versus absolute chirality distinguished; adjacent DDVA route proposed; atomic mechanism modeled.

figures.disposition: 1A exact gallate branch; GalA O2, GalD OMA-to-CHM, GalB H2O, GalC OAA/PYR. Box shows uncertain CHM geometry. 1B is neighboring proposed biphenyl/CHPD/HMG route.

GalBNt protomer/hexamer and interfaces inspected. Image panel C labels helix contact, D beta contact, E threefold contact; caption/result C/E descriptions are not consistently aligned. No residue-specific edge created from panel-letter assumption.
Electron/anomalous density and metal-site schematic inspected; H14,D17,E48,H127 plus water around zinc. Overlays are comparative proteins.
Active site and modeled E,E-CHM inspected; model sidechains rotated. LigJ structure is R. palustris, not E6 assay protein. No ligand-bound crystal claim.
Solid GalB/LigJ CHA-product curves are negative, racemic CHA/HMG depletion curves are positive. Optical sign measured at 589 nm; no R/S derivation from sign.
A extinction coefficient, B pKm, C log(kcat), D log(kcat/Km) according to actual axes. Caption swaps B/C. Two cofactor pH series inspected.
E48A/H164A pH profiles inspected, zinc condition retained. Does not directly image proton movement.
Both panels and all displayed cluster rows inspected; small MultiGeneBlast sample, homology-only scope. Displayed taxon classification inconsistencies are not copied as biological authority.
All panels inspected. Model depicts S-CHA but caption explicitly leaves absolute configuration of observed negative CHA unknown. Proton-transfer scheme remains proposed.

tables.disposition: All parsed rows inspected; diffraction/model statistics for GalBNt, not full-length protein; two zinc ions in two-copy asymmetric unit do not mean two zinc per monomer.
All metal, native, native+Co, apo and EDTA rows inspected; conditional residual activity preserved; paper-specific specific-activity units not silently normalized.
All WT/A16D/E48A/H127A/H14A-D17A binding rows inspected; NS means cannot saturate <=500 micromolar, not no binding.
All WT metal/substrate and variant rows inspected; substrate-specific effects, both reaction directions and non-saturation retained.
All metal and variant pH rows inspected; distinguish table estimates from slightly different narrative rounded values.

equations.disposition: Bound metal equals total minus free.
Saturable bound-metal fit using free metal and Kd.
Two ascending protonation factors plus alkaline term as displayed; do not infer extra biochemical species from fit equation.
